description: Vendor unit costs used to estimate what a weekly LaunchTrace run costs and what the gross margin is at £79/month. Every figure here is EDITABLE and every one is an assumption until you have a real invoice. Nothing in the code fetches live pricing.
verification_note: Each entry carries a 'confidence' and a 'source_note'. 'assumed' means nobody has confirmed it. Replace assumed figures with your real bill as soon as you have one, then re-run: python -m src.admin business-status
fx_note: Vendor prices quoted in USD are converted at the rate below. Update it when it drifts.

line_items.label: Web enrichment searches (Tavily free tier)
line_items.source_note: Tavily free tier gives 1,000 searches/month and a weekly run is capped at SEARCH_MAX_CANDIDATES_PER_RUN (150). Four runs a month stay inside the free tier, so the marginal cost is zero until you exceed it.

line_items.label: Web enrichment searches beyond the free tier
line_items.source_note: ASSUMED. Only applies once you pass 1,000 searches/month. Set units_per_weekly_run above zero if you move to a paid plan, and put the real per-search price here.

line_items.label: LLM product classification
line_items.source_note: ASSUMED, and only incurred if LLM_PROVIDER is set. Based on a small model and roughly 700 input plus 150 output tokens per candidate, capped at LLM_MAX_CANDIDATES_PER_RUN. Replace with your provider's actual per-token price.

line_items.label: Companies House lookups
line_items.source_note: Free. Both routes (REST API and the bulk snapshot) cost nothing.

line_items.label: UKIPO journal retrieval
line_items.source_note: Free. Open Government Licence v3.0 data.

line_items.label: Weekly feed and transactional email (Resend)
line_items.source_note: Resend free tier is 3,000 emails/month. At roughly 6 emails per customer per month (4 weekly feeds plus transactional), the free tier covers about 500 customers. Marginal cost is zero well past the first hundred.

line_items.label: Hosted PostgreSQL (Supabase)
line_items.source_note: Supabase free tier. Becomes about £2000/month pence (£20) on the Pro plan, which you will not need at single-digit customer counts.

line_items.label: Website and pipeline hosting (Fly.io)
line_items.source_note: ASSUMED £4/month for one small always-on machine. Fly's free allowance may cover it entirely. Replace with your real bill.

line_items.label: Domain registration
line_items.source_note: ASSUMED about £12/year for a .co.uk, spread monthly.

line_items.label: Stripe transaction fees
line_items.source_note: Stripe UK standard pricing: 1.5% + 20p per successful domestic card charge. Only incurred when you are paid.

line_items.label: ICO data protection fee
line_items.source_note: £40–60 a year for a tier 1 controller, taken here as £48/year spread monthly. Payable once you process personal data as a controller.

runs_per_month_note: 52 weekly runs a year divided by 12.
plan_price_note: The founding monthly price. Kept here so the margin calculation has something to divide by; config/customer_plans.json remains the source of truth for what customers are actually charged.
